tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Salons, spas, barbers, clinics and other businesses on WAJ that take bookings through AI assistants, by name, service, category or area, nearest first when a location is given. Each result has a `business` value that identifies the business.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: The business's name, description, contact phone, currency, booking website, and its branches with address, phone, opening hours, time zone and a booking link for each.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Services and packages that can be booked online, grouped by category, with duration in minutes and price in the business currency (options, offers and lowest price where they apply). Filter by branch, category or text.

tools.name: list_staff
tools.description: Professionals customers can choose when booking online, optionally only those who perform a given service (with their price for it, in the business currency) or work at a given branch.

tools.name: find_available_times
tools.description: Open start times for a service or package at a branch, for one day or up to 7 consecutive days, with any professional or a chosen one. Times are local to the branch. These are the times the business's booking website offers; they are not held.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: A link to the business's booking website with the branch, service or package, professional and, optionally, an open start time pre-selected (the time is re-checked first). The booking, the customer's details and any payment are completed on the website.
